elaine: Quick mid‑quarter stitch check — posting a compact status update for the Q milestone list. Please reply with one-line status, owner, and any blockers by EOD.

Aisha: Shipped: onboarding quickstarts + team templates. Owner: Aisha. Next: migrate 2 pilot customers to Dedicated this week. No blockers. :tada:

ben: Shipped: prefix/KV cache landed in prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 — perf looks good for 95th pctile. Owner: ben.

carlo: Quantization rollout slipped — seeing a perf regression on one A100 job (tail latency spike). Root cause looks like kernel selection fallback. Owner: carlo. Blocker: need perf logs and kernel trace.

dana: I'll pair with @carlo for the kernel trace and reproduce. Also flagged a small eval regression (hallucination delta) on the new quant profile, putting notes in the eval dashboard. ETA for triage: Thu.

elaine: Actionable recap: 1) carlo + dana triage perf + evals (owner carlo/dana) 2) ben to prepare rollback runbook for affected customers 3) Aisha to update roadmap entries and communicate to pilots. If blocked, call it out.

ben: Rollback runbook created: https://confluence.redwood/teams/runtime/runbooks/rollback-quant — includes contact list and fallback model mapping. Added steps to invalidate prefix cache on rollback.

carlo: Ping @ben for kernel perf logs; here is a quick command I ran to collect metrics: ```nvidia-smi dmon -s u -o DT```. Uploading the full dmon dump to the thread in a sec.

deploy-bot: prod deploy r-2026.03.18 — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark: — note: rollout paused in region-eu due to higher lat p95, flagged for investigation.

Aisha: CR ping @carlo — can you review my infra dedupe change (infra-shim) when free? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/999. It's blocking next customer migration step.

carlo: Will prioritize triage then do the CR review. ETA review by 4pm PT. If I hit a blocker, I'll post updates here.

elaine: Thanks team. If anything slips beyond Thu, we'll escalate to a short warroom. Otherwise, please update the milestone board and mark owners.

ben: Noted — updating milestone board now.

dana: Adding test vectors to the eval harness; will post results here when ready.

Aisha: I'll send a short customer note draft after roadmap update.

elaine: Perfect. Short follow-ups only after this thread — appreciate the quick replies. :thumbsup:
